instruction: Fix `split_words` in `parselib/textutil.py` so it splits on runs of any whitespace, not single spaces. The current code uses `str.split(" ")`, so tabs and repeated/leading/trailing spaces produce empty tokens or fail to split at all.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/parselib/textutil.py b/parselib/textutil.py
--- a/parselib/textutil.py
+++ b/parselib/textutil.py
@@ -20,7 +20,7 @@
     ``"a  b"`` -> ``["a", "b"]``; never emits empty tokens for leading,
     trailing, or repeated whitespace.
     """
-    return text.split(" ")
+    return text.split()
 
 
 def parse_kv(line: str, sep: str = "=") -> tuple[str, str] | None:
